metadata.title: Measurement that ends in a decision
metadata.scope: Proposed client reporting architecture; no live connections or private metrics. Cadence follows SEOasis’s public reporting and quarterly review language.
metadata.limitations: No account baselines, actual integration health, revenue attribution, forecasts or incrementality estimates. Proposed fields and cadences must be agreed with the team.

summary: Keep delivery evidence, search response and commercial outcomes connected by page and product cohorts. A report should explain what changed, what the evidence supports, what remains uncertain and what happens next.

measurementContract.title: Revenue definition

source.title: Shopify Help Center | Sales reports
source.note: Official definitions distinguish gross sales, net sales and total sales. Reconcile discounts, returns, shipping, taxes, fees and timing before comparisons.

measurementContract.rule: Agree whether the headline uses gross sales, net sales or purchase revenue. Show discounts, returns, shipping, taxes, duties and fees explicitly. Revenue is not profit.

measurementContract.title: Attribution scope
measurementContract.evidence: Attribution assigns credit under configured settings.

source.title: Get started with attribution - Analytics Help
source.note: Attribution assigns credit under a specified model. Credited revenue is not proof of causal incremental lift.

measurementContract.rule: Record session acquisition versus event attribution, model, lookback window, reporting identity, channel rules, currency and timezone. Avoid adding model-credit and session-credit totals.

measurementContract.title: Cross-system reconciliation
measurementContract.evidence: GA4 ecommerce uses transaction IDs; Shopify records actual orders.

source.title: Measure ecommerce | Google Analytics | Google for Developers
source.note: Official implementation guide describes list/detail/cart/checkout/purchase/refund events, transaction IDs, item data and currency.

measurementContract.rule: Compare order IDs and amounts for agreed dates; explain consent, blockers, duplication, refund timing and currency differences. Use finance-approved order totals for net sales.

measurementContract.title: Acquisition separation
measurementContract.evidence: Search, Shopping, referrals and model observations answer different questions.

source.title: Default channel group - Analytics Help
source.note: Official channel classification reference; Organic Shopping and Organic Search must be segmented consistently rather than combined without definition.

measurementContract.rule: Report Organic Search, Organic Shopping and identified AI referrals separately. AI referrals undercount exposure; prompt-panel presence is not platform-wide visibility.

measurementContract.title: Incrementality
measurementContract.evidence: No experiment or counterfactual is available.

source.title: Get started with attribution - Analytics Help
source.note: Attribution assigns credit under a specified model. Credited revenue is not proof of causal incremental lift.

measurementContract.whyItMatters: Separates credited sales from additional sales caused by work.
measurementContract.decision: Use a defensible matched/control cohort or experimental design where feasible; annotate seasonality, promotions, stock, price, paid media and site changes. Before/after lift remains an association without a credible counterfactual.

measurementContract.title: Cohort and denominator discipline

source.title: Performance report (Search results): Overview and basic setup - Search Console Help
source.note: Official report documentation for Search clicks, impressions, CTR and average position; performance requires verified property access.

measurementContract.rule: Freeze the tested URL/product cohort, release date and denominator. Separate brand/nonbrand where supportable; compare similar weekdays and seasonal periods; state missing query rows and small samples.

measurementContract.title: Decision log
measurementContract.evidence: Proposed operating record aligned to quarterly recalibration.

measurementContract.rule: Every finding closes with evidence, confidence, owner, next action, due date and the condition that changes the recommendation. Save historical reports rather than overwriting the baseline.

prioritizationScenarios.action: Use impact as an explicit ordinal hypothesis, confidence from evidence and effort from implementation review. Fix measurement/eligibility blockers and pilot one coherent workstream.

prioritizationScenarios.title: After private data: prioritize commercial constraints
prioritizationScenarios.evidence: Proposed account decision once orders, stock and economics are reconciled.

prioritizationScenarios.action: A high-impression category with weak conversion may warrant UX diagnosis; a well-converting category with viable inventory may warrant expansion. Stock, margin and client priorities can outweigh traffic potential. Do not turn attribution into a guaranteed revenue forecast.
